description: This file implements a generic Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) processor with various size-specific algorithms, including radix-2, radix-3, radix-5, and arbitrary sizes, utilizing templates and SIMD optimizations. It defines classes for different DFT sizes and a main implementation class that selects the appropriate algorithm based on configuration.

classes.name: generic_dft_dit
classes.description: Template class implementing various sizes of Decimation-In-Time (DIT) FFT algorithms, including arbitrary sizes, optimized for specific cases and SIMD.

methods.name: dft_processor_generic_impl::run
methods.description: Executes the selected DFT algorithm on input data and returns the output span.
